name: Seedfall Palm
description: Strike with a palm that withers the skin and leaves a seed of living growth in the wound.

name: Mulch Guard
description: Guard with a forearm of rotting leaf-mould qi that cushions a blow and feeds the ground.

name: Compost Step
description: Step softly over a bed of rotting growth that swallows sound and muddies the foe's aim.

name: Spore Touch
description: Touch the foe's wrist and seed a sprouting rot that makes the grip uncertain.

name: Rootrot Grasp
description: Seize a limb and grow thin rotting roots through it that hold the arm fast.

name: Mulching Press
description: Press a flat palm to the chest and turn the flesh beneath it slowly to soft mulch.

name: Renewal Ebb
description: Ebb a lingering blight out of an ally and let fresh health grow where it was.

name: Rotted Bloom
description: Fling a rotted blossom of qi that bursts on the foe and spreads a clinging weakness.

name: Fading Blossom
description: Let a great pale blossom open over foes and fade as it drains the vigour from each.

name: Gentle Decay
description: Let a deep curse in an ally decay softly into soil and take the harm away with it.

name: Perishing Bloom
description: Open a vast bloom of ending qi over the field whose petals strip the life from all they touch.

name: Last Bloom
description: streams: Death + Life; run ending through a living foe until the body flowers once and is consumed in the bloom.

name: Terminus Palm
description: Strike with a palm that leaves a pale ghost-chill lingering in the struck muscle.

name: Spirit Veil
description: Draw a thin veil of departing spirit before the body that deadens the weight of a blow.

name: Lingering Step
description: Step aside and leave a faint after-image that the foe's blow passes through.

name: Echo Touch
description: Touch the brow and echo a dying thought through the foe's mind so he loses his place.

name: Spirit Drain
description: Draw at the edge of the foe's spirit so that every effort of will costs him double.

name: Dying Echo
description: Strike the body and let the blow ring again in the spirit a heartbeat later.

name: Erosion Ease
description: Ease the early erosion of an ally's soul by letting the worn edges end and heal.

name: Departing Whisper
description: Whisper the sound of a leaving soul into the foe's ear until he forgets what he fears.

name: Soulward Ending
description: Thrust a line of ending qi through the body and out the far side where the spirit sits.

name: Terminal Whisper
description: Whisper the end of a name until the foe's limbs forget how to move.

name: Spirit Absolution
description: Let a fragmenting soul wound end quietly and the soul settle whole in an ally.

name: Terminus Wail
description: Send a long wail of ending into the soul of one foe and tear at its hold on the body.

name: Terminus Silence
description: streams: Death + Soul; show a foe the terminus his soul will meet until body and spirit go silent together.

name: Vacant Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries a hollow absence into the muscle it touches.

name: Voided Guard
description: Hold a guard with nothing in it for a blow to strike against.

name: Soundless Fade
description: Step where no sound follows and the ground gives back no echo.

name: Muting Touch
description: Touch the throat and take the voice and the shout away for a few breaths.

name: Hollowing Grasp
description: Hold a limb and empty it of strength until it hangs without a will of its own.

name: Cessation Jab
description: Jab a pressure point and cease the working of one limb entirely for a breath.

name: Void Easing
description: Pass a poison out of an ally into a small emptiness that holds nothing and lets it go.

name: Dampening Void
description: Spread a dampening emptiness over a foe so that his qi cannot find purchase.

name: Unvoiced Ending
description: Drive a soundless ending through the guard so that the blow is felt after it lands.

name: Muted Weight
description: Make a wide stretch around the user silent and weightless so foes within cannot gather force.

name: Silence Remedy
description: Hold an ally within the silence until the clamour of a curse falls still and breaks.

name: Cessation Eclipse
description: Draw a darkness of ceased things over the field in which no foe can gather or strike.

name: Voiding Quietus
description: streams: Death + Void; end a foe's sound and strength and being together in one long quiet.

name: Void Unmaking
description: streams: Death + Void; unmake the living part of a single target and leave only an unmarked emptiness.
